-- Create credential
create DATABASE SCOPED CREDENTIAL vishnucreds
with 
    IDENTITY = 'Managed Identity'

    -- ----------------------------

-- External data source
CREATE EXTERNAL data SOURCE raw_ext_source_abfss1
with (
    LOCATION = 'abfss://raw@synapsedatalakevishnu.dfs.core.windows.net',
    CREDENTIAL = vishnucreds
)

CREATE EXTERNAL data SOURCE raw_ext_source
with (
    LOCATION = 'https://synapsedatalakevishnu.dfs.core.windows.net/raw/',
    CREDENTIAL = vishnucreds
)
-- -------------------------

-- Create parquet filr format
create EXTERNAL file FORMAT parquet_format
with
(
    FORMAT_TYPE = PARQUET,
    DATA_COMPRESSION = 'org.apache.hadoop.io.compress.SnappyCodec'
)

---------------------------------
